citation: Yoshida et al. 2022. Age-Related Sex Differences in Glucose Tolerance by 75 g Oral Glucose Tolerance Test in Japanese. Nutrients 14:4868.
protocol: 75 g OGTT after 12 h fast; blood at 0, 30, 60, 120 min
population: 505 young men (23.7 y), 280 young women (23.3 y), 127 middle-aged men, 244 middle-aged women (all comers, NGT to diabetes), Japan
note: Only AUCs (0-120 min) and fasting values are in the table. The young groups are mostly NGT (82-94%), middle-aged groups include IGT and diabetes, so use young groups as the healthy set.
